ñeyya: [Ñā+ṇya] (ti) CL=7 Ñātabbaṃ ñeyyaṃ. Kaccaññaḥ.544. Ñā avabodhane, aññāyittha ñāyati ñāyissatīti ñeyyaṃ.rū.556.ñātabbaṃ ñeyyaṃ, saṅkhāravikāralakkhaṇanibbānapaññattidhammā. Īdisesu ṭhānesu ñeyyasaddo ekantena napuṃsako, vāccaliṅgatthe sabbaliṅgiko, yathā¿ñeyyophasso. Ñeyyā vedanā. Ñeyyaṃ cittaṃ. Nīti,dhā.249.ñāṇa+ṇeyya] Should be known.Ñeyya(ti) [ñeyya+ṇa] (Sutta) which has the dhammas which should be known.
ñeyyaabhimukha: [Ñeyya+abhimukha] (ti) CL=7 Looking forward to the Dhamma that should be known (or) It is foremost the dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyadhamma: [Ñeyya+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 The dhamma which is worth to know (or) which should be known, Ñeyyadhaṃ dhamma. (Ñeyyadhaṃ means the dhamma which should be known, there are five kinds of Ñeyyadhaṃ dhamma:(1) reforming(volition), (2) changing for the worse,(3) The sign (cause of recognization), (4) Nibbanna,(5) to be known in many ways(Panyatti)).
ñeyyajānanaṭṭha: [Ñeyya+jānana+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of knowing the dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyajāta: [Ñeyya+jāta] (na) CL=7 All the Dhammas that should be known.
ñeyyapariyantika: [Ñeyya+pariyanta+ika] (ti) CL=7 There is an end/limit and devision/demarcation that is the dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyapariyantikañāṇa: [Ñeyyapariyantika+ñāṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who has an end and division wisdom that is the dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyapavattipatha: [Ñeyya+pavatti+patha] (pu) CL=7 The cause of being the dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyappabheda: [Ñeyya+pabheda] (pu) CL=7 There are many kinds of dhammas which should be known.
ñeyyappakāsana: [Ñeyya+pakāsana] (ti) CL=7 It shows obvious the dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyasabhāvatta: [Ñeyya+sabhāva+tta] (na) CL=7 As a matter of fact, it should be known.
ñeyyasāgara: [Ñeyya+sāgara] (pu) CL=7 It is the ocean that is Ñeyyadhaṃ dhammas, Ñeyyadhaṃ dhammas like the ocean. (Ñeyyadhaṃ means the dhamma which should be known, there are five kinds of Ñeyyadhaṃ dhamma:(1) reforming(volition), (2) changing for the worse,(3) The sign (cause of recognization), (4) Nibbanna,(5) to be known in many ways(Panyatti)).
ñeyyasāgarapāragū: [Ñeyyasāgara+pāra+gamu+rū] (ti) CL=7 One who is the other side of ocean that is Ñeyyadhaṃ dhamma. (Ñeyyadhaṃ means the dhamma which should be known, there are five kinds of Ñeyyadhaṃ dhamma:(1) reforming(volition), (2) changing for the worse,(3) The sign (cause of recognization), (4) Nibbanna,(5) to be known in many ways(Panyatti)).
ñeyyattha: [Ñeyya+attha] (pu) CL=7 It has meaning which should be known.
ñeyyavisesa: [Ñeyya+visesa] (pu) CL=7 It is special dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyavisesapariggāhikabhāva: [Ñeyya+visesa+pariggāhika+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As a person who confiscates (attains)  the special dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyaṭṭhāna: [Ñeyya+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 Things (or) department (or) business/matter which should be known.
ñeyyāvabodha: [Ñeyya+avabodha] (pu) CL=7 Insight into the Dhamma that should be known.
ñeyyāvaraṇa: [Ñeyya+āvaraṇa] (ti) CL=7 It can block and cover the dhamma which should be known.
ñeyyāvaraṇappahāna: [Ñeyyāvaraṇa+pahāna] (na) CL=7 (1) Rejected the lust that can block the dhamma which should be known. (Ti) (2) Can be rejected the lust  that can block the dhamma which should be known.
